body: Media: /gta7tv places a real TextDisplay entity (Paper 1.19.4+, no resource pack, confirmed real via javap before coding) showing a rolling feed of recent claims/flips/Contest Windows/Enforcement callouts/Party Store closures. Factions: /faction join <FREQUENCY|BLOC|PROCUREMENT>, the three player-alignable factions from NORTHSTAR.md's own table; real Bukkit Team for nametag color, reputation from claims (+5)/flips (+10), YAML-persisted, re-applied on join. Added README.md with connection instructions (mirrors EINHORN_SURVIVAL) and a full how-to-play guide covering every system shipped so far. Built, deployed, confirmed enabling cleanly in server.log with zero exceptions.
title: VS3 -- Media broadcast TVs + Factions, plus README
